added.title: Executive Director, Partner Product Modernization
added.description:
Job Description

Start your next chapter leading large-scale modernization that reshapes how customers and partners experience card products. You'll connect vision to delivery across teams, platforms, and partners—turning complexity into momentum.

As a Modernization Portfolio Product Leader
in Co-brand and Partner Product
, you drive the cross-product strategy, sequencing, and execution of modernization workstreams that modernize experiences, capabilities, and platforms. You operate at the intersection of product, technology, data, and design to unlock measurable business value while ensuring foundational work is built to support responsible AI-enabled experiences.

Job responsibilities

Define and own the cross-product modernization vision, outcomes, and multi-quarter roadmap across participating products and platforms
Align product leaders and technology partners on scope, sequencing, and shared accountability across a matrixed organization
Establish target-state principles for architecture, integration standards, governance, and migration approach to drive consistent delivery
Build and maintain a holistic dependency map, critical path plan, and release sequencing across multiple roadmaps and partner implementations
Stand up the operating model (cadence, forums, decision rights, escalation paths) to enable fast, transparent decision-making
Translate strategy into executable delivery artifacts, including program epics, milestones, requirements, acceptance criteria, and resourcing assumptions
Define success metrics and reporting mechanisms (scorecards, narratives, risks, tradeoffs, decisions needed) for executive stakeholders
Identify, document, and mitigate risks across technical delivery, operations, compliance, data, and partner/vendor dependencies
Drive simplification and standardization by promoting reusable capabilities, common API patterns, data contracts, identity, and reporting standards
Ensure modernization foundations are designed to support responsible use of AI and data capabilities without rework later

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

10 years of experience leading complex, cross-functional programs or portfolios across product, platform, data, or technology
Demonstrated experience aligning multiple product roadmaps and delivering shared capabilities across a matrixed organization
Strong knowledge of modern integration and data exchange patterns, such as APIs, event-driven architectures, data contracts, and migration strategies
Working fluency in current AI capabilities and limitations, including the ability to assess where AI changes target-state decisions versus adds cost without value
Experience defining measurable success metrics, establishing reporting cadences, and using data to drive prioritization and decisions
Proven ability to influence without direct authority and facilitate tradeoffs with senior stakeholders
Ability to communicate complex strategy and technical tradeoffs clearly to executives, product leaders, and engineering partners
Experience embedding risk, controls, and governance into program delivery, especially related to customer data and platform modernization

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

Experience modernizing partner-facing onboarding, servicing, or integration journeys
Experience building cross-product operating rhythms and governance for large modernization programs
Familiarity with designing foundations for intelligent decisioning and AI-assisted customer experiences with appropriate controls and human review

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US. We are not able to provide immigration sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Final job grade level and corporate title will be determined at time of offer and may differ from this posting.

Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

added.title: Private Bank, Digital Product Manager  - Distribution in Kind, Vice President
added.description:
Job Description

Role Overview

The JPM Private Bank Digital Team is seeking a Product Manager
to help drive the Private Bank's client and advisor experiences. As part of our ambition to build an industry-leading digital experience for Funds, this role will lead an exciting initiative to serve private equity and venture capital clients who distribute securities rather than cash. Central to delivering this experience is expanding and automating our distribution in-kind capabilities
. The lead will partner closely with advisors, sales leadership, Service, analytics, design, technology and AI teams to facilitate a new offering.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Execution

Lead the product strategy and roadmap for client and advisor digital experiences for distribution in-kind and payments—from the collection of instructions to the processing and playback of transactions.
Translate advisor, banker, and leadership needs into clear product requirements, user stories, workflows, and success criteria.
Partner with design, technology, analytics, and AI teams to deliver digital tools that expand our distribution in-kind capabilities for a key client group.
Manage product backlog prioritization in partnership with senior product leads and business stakeholders.
Drive execution across discovery, requirements, testing, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
Gather advisor feedback on AI-powered tools to ensure recommendations are practical, explainable, and aligned to real-world workflows.
Monitor adoption and effectiveness of AI-enabled features and recommend enhancements based on data and user feedback.

Advisor & Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as a voice of the client and the advisor within the Digital Team, bringing practical insight from the field into product decisions.
Conduct user interviews, feedback sessions, journey mapping, and workflow reviews with advisors, bankers, managers, and support teams.
Build strong relationships with Private Bank stakeholders to understand business priorities and ensure digital solutions align with advisor needs.
Support training, communications, and adoption efforts for new or enhanced lead, prospect, and AI-enabled tools.

Data, Measurement & Optimization

Define KPIs for distribution in-kind initiatives, including efficiencies, revenue, and assets retained.
Partner with analytics and reporting teams to monitor product performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Use data and user feedback to recommend enhancements, prioritize features, and improve business outcomes.
Help create consistent measurement frameworks for prospect pipeline management across teams and regions.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in product management, financial services, wealth management, banking, payments and securities transfers, digital transformation, or related roles.
Strong understanding of client and advisor experiences around payments and distributions.
Demonstrated interest in AI, data-driven decisioning, automation, or digital productivity tools.
Ability to translate business needs into clear product requirements and partner effectively with design, technology, analytics, data science, and business teams.
Strong analytical skills with comfort using data to assess performance, identify trends, and make product recommendations.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in client engagement or as a client advisor, banker, service team or digital product.
Experience supporting high-net-worth or ultra-high-net-worth client segments.
Experience working in Agile product development environments.
Interest in emerging AI capabilities and how they can be responsibly applied to improve advisor workflows.
Understanding of digital adoption, change management, and field enablement within a large financial institution.

Success Measures

This person will be successful if they help the organization:

Create an engaging client digital experience and a transparent advisor digital experience.
Facilitate securities distributions for a key client segment.
Automate end-to-end processing of distributions in-kind.
Help retain client assets by introducing new digital capabilities.
Reduce manual effort and fragmented processes across banking teams.
Identify practical AI use cases that improve advisor productivity and prospect engagement.
Bring authentic advisor perspective into product design and prioritization.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

added.title: Principal Product Manager, Partner Integrations
added.description:
Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and $250M ARR, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company's sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

We're hiring a Product Manager to own partner integrations at ClickHouse
. This role owns how ClickHouse shows up inside the platforms our customers already use: embedded, native experiences across the hyperscalers and developer platforms, and deeper technical integrations with strategic partners like dbt, Fivetran, Hex, and Sigma. There is a growing surface of partner work already in motion, and this role shapes where we invest in co-innovation opportunities.

This is one of the most cross-functional roles at ClickHouse. You'll work across multiple engineering teams, our partnerships and solutions teams, and the partners themselves to deliver meaningful co-innovation and integrations with complementary technologies. You'll own the technical side of our House Mates partner program and be the person who navigates the multi-org reality of getting an integration certified, listed, and live. This is a hands-on role: you'll write the specs, run the partner calls, drive certification processes, and coordinate across teams to get things over the line.

You Will

Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for ClickHouse's Cloud integrations with strategic partners
Seek out complementary innovation opportunities with partners. Define what a "better together" integration looks like with each strategic partner, and drive it from joint roadmap through launch.
Navigate the trade-offs of embedded integrations: billing and metering, identity and auth, security and data residency, and coordination across ClickHouse and partner teams.
Project-manage complex, multi-org launches: marketplace listings, certification processes, partner co-marketing, and GA timelines across multiple organizations.
Own the technical standards and certification criteria for integrations submitted through the House Mates partner program.
Measure and communicate co-innovation business impact, adoption and product strategy to executive leadership.
Represent ClickHouse externally at partner events and in joint content.

You Bring

Experience shipping integrations into third-party platforms before: hyperscaler marketplaces, embedded or native integrations, ISV partnerships, or OEM/white-label work.
An understanding of the trade-offs that make or break a partner integration, billing, auth, security, cross-team dependencies, and have made those decisions in the past.
A strong project management lens and are comfortable owning a launch that depends on five teams across two companies.
Patience and resilience with partners who are unresponsive or have their own competing priorities, and you find creative ways to keep things moving anyway.
Technical ability to understand an integration end to end, from provisioning and auth to billing and data flow, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about APIs, architecture, and technical trade-offs.
Energy and excitement for external-facing work: partner calls, customer conversations, and representing the product publicly.
Hands-on and high ownership ability. You write the specs, run the partner calls, and stay close to the details.
Comfort in ambiguity and fast-moving environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience building partner integrations with hyperscalers and modern technology companies.
Experience running or supporting a technology partner program.
Background at a database or data infrastructure company; familiarity with ClickHouse or peers like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
Experience working in remote, multi-timezone environments.

Perks

Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

added.title: Director, Product Development Engineering - Optics
added.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview

AI and hyperscale computing are fundamentally changing data-center architecture, making optics increasingly critical to how advanced systems connect and scale.

TE Connectivity is developing the next generation of optical interconnect technologies, spanning fiber connectivity and structured cabling, free-space optics, precision optical interfaces, and high-volume manufacturing solutions.

The Director, Product Development Engineering will build and rapidly scale a world-class engineering organization with the talent, technical capabilities, processes, and infrastructure required to support the extraordinary growth of AI and hyperscale infrastructure. This leader will establish the engineering vision and operating model, strengthen technical and organizational capabilities, and develop the next generation of engineering leaders

The role spans free-space optics, fiber connectivity and structured cabling, precision optical and mechanical systems, plastics and polymers, metals, glass and optical materials, precision assembly, and high-volume manufacturing for AI, hyperscale data-center, optical communications, and high-performance computing applications.

Location: There is a strong preference for the selected candidate to be based in Rochester, NY and be able to work in a hybrid setting. We will offer relocation for the selected candidate if needed.

Key Responsibilities

Build and scale the engineering organization, including organizational structure, talent, capabilities, capacity, and strategic investments.
Establish clear engineering direction, processes, technical standards, and decision-making practices that improve speed, quality, and overall effectiveness.
Develop the technologies, platforms, processes, and reusable engineering capabilities needed to rapidly address emerging customer and market opportunities.
Balance near-term customer and product-development priorities with longer-term technology exploration, capability development, and risk reduction.
Translate advanced technologies and innovative concepts into practical, reliable, cost-effective products and scalable, high-volume manufacturing solutions.
Develop and mentor Sr. Managers, emerging engineering leaders, and technical experts while strengthening succession and creating opportunities for career growth.
Foster collaboration across TE’s global engineering, manufacturing, materials, automation, and technology organizations to leverage capabilities, expertise, and best practices.
Build and maintain a strong external technology ecosystem across strategic suppliers, equipment and process partners, technology and IP providers, and specialized engineering resources.
Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Manufacturing, customers, and senior leadership to align technical strategy with business and market priorities.
Establish an engineering organization recognized for technical depth, execution, innovation, process excellence, and the ability to scale.

What Your Background Should Look Like

Bachelor’s degree in Optical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
Typically 15+ years of engineering or product-development experience, including significant progressive engineering leadership experience.
Proven success building and leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through significant growth, transformation, or change.
Strong technical foundation across relevant areas such as optics, fiber connectivity, precision mechanical systems, materials, plastics, metals, glass, precision manufacturing, or high-volume assembly.
Technical depth and judgment to challenge assumptions, assess technical risk, guide complex decisions, and earn the credibility of experienced engineers and technical experts.
Demonstrated ability to improve engineering effectiveness through organizational design, talent and capability development, processes, tools, and disciplined technical decision-making.
Experience translating emerging or advanced technologies into practical products and scalable manufacturing approaches.
Experience in fast-moving technology markets such as hyperscale data centers, optical communications, high-performance computing, or semiconductor technology strongly preferred.
Proven ability to build productive internal and external technical networks across customers, suppliers, technology partners, manufacturing organizations, and global engineering teams.
Strong business judgment, communication, collaboration, and influencing skills across technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to balance immediate execution needs with longer-term technology strategy and capability development.
Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

#TEOpticsJobs #USOpticsJobs

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

added.title: Senior Product Strategy Manager
added.description:
Overview

At PowerSchool, we are a dedicated team of innovators guided by our shared purpose of powering personalized education for students around the world. From the central office to the classroom to the home, PowerSchool supports the entire educational ecosystem as the global leader of cloud-based software for K-12 education. Our employees make it all possible, and a career with us means you’re joining a successful team committed to engaging, empowering, and improving the K-12 education experience everywhere.

Team Overview

Our Product team leads the direction, coordination, output, quality, and enhancements to PowerSchool’s product portfolio. This dynamic, multi-functional team ensures the effective rollout of new products across the platform, packages and positions products to appeal to consumers, and helps set the future direction and pace of innovation in our organization.

Description

Responsibilities

The Senior Manager, Product Strategy plays a critical role in advancing PowerSchool’s product and portfolio strategy across the Student Information and Family Engagement portfolios. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Strategy, this role is responsible for delivering data-driven analysis and strategic recommendations that inform business decisions and drive growth, retention, and profitability.

Working cross-functionally with leaders across Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, the Senior Manager is expected to influence executive decision-making through clear insights, strategic thinking, and compelling executive-level storytelling. Over time, this individual will be expected to progressively take ownership of a solution area, serving as a strategic partner in shaping portfolio direction, identifying growth opportunities, and driving long-term business performance.

Your Day-to-day Job Will Consist Of

Leading end-to-end research initiatives—including customer discovery, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking—synthesizing complex data into actionable insights, opportunity areas, and strategic recommendations that inform product strategy and roadmap prioritization
Conducting quarterly and ad hoc performance analyses across bookings, pipeline, win/loss, retention, and product metrics, translating findings into clear narratives for senior leadership and Board audiences
Maintaining deep expertise in K-12 market dynamics, including district and school customer needs, competitive activity, policy developments, and emerging trends, proactively identifying implications for pricing, packaging, positioning, and go-to-market execution
Building rigorous business cases to support evaluation of product investments, strategic partnerships, and adjacent market opportunities, balancing growth potential with long-term portfolio profitability
Contributing to cross-functional planning efforts by providing timely market, customer, and competitive insights that support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success
Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum of 5+ years of experience in product strategy, strategy consulting, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
Demonstrated ability to synthesize secondary and primary research, market landscape findings, data from business results, and competitive intelligence resources
Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to analyze performance trends and translate insights into strategic recommendations
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with experience creating executive‑ and Board‑level materials
Travel occasionally, up to 10%, for key moments such as team summits, training, customer meetings, company events, etc., with increased frequency during peak periods based on business demands.
This position is subject to company on call policies which constitutes working hours outside of the normal workday as needed.
Additional experience may be substitute for an advanced Degree.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in EdTech, SaaS, or enterprise software organizations
Proficiency in Salesforce, Power BI, or similar CRM and business intelligence platforms
Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for data analysis and executive-level presentations
Knowledge of the Student Information System (SIS), Enrollment, Family Engagement, or related K-12 education technology markets

added.title: Director, Digital Product Portfolio Enablement
added.description:
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Director, Digital Product Portfolio Enablement

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will help drive the evolution of product management at Amgen by strengthening how digital product strategy, business outcomes, portfolio priorities, governance, and investment decisions connect across the enterprise. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Management Portfolio Enablement and Governance, this leader will operate at the nexus of Business, Product Management, Technology, and Finance, helping leaders across those functions and the enterprise align the broader digital product strategy with its intended outcomes.

This role will serve as a product management best-practices expert, bringing the rigor, facilitation, structured problem solving, portfolio management, and executive communication needed to design and continuously improve the enterprise forums and operating rhythms through which senior Digital Product portfolio leaders engage with business leadership to align and prioritize. The Director will help shape clear narratives, frame strategic choices, surface trade-offs, and prepare for high-value discussions with senior executives.

The Director will primarily lead the design and effective execution of Technology Portfolio Reviews, the highest-level forums where senior Digital Product portfolio leaders engage with SVPs, EVPs, and other enterprise executives on functional digital strategy, portfolio choices, investment priorities, business outcomes, and value realization. The role will also ensure that Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews, and related product operating rhythms across product teams and product groups are executed consistently and in alignment with the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM).

Responsibilities:

Technology Portfolio Reviews and Executive Product Forums

Lead the design, preparation, facilitation, and continuous improvement of Technology Portfolio Reviews, the highest-level product and portfolio forums for SVP, EVP, and other enterprise executive engagement.
Help senior Digital Product portfolio leaders articulate a coherent functional digital strategy across business outcomes, technology direction, investment priorities, AI and data opportunities, risks, dependencies, and value realization.
Establish clear expectations for forum structure, storyline, evidence, decision points, trade-offs, and follow-through so executive discussions are oriented toward choices and measurable outcomes rather than status reporting.
Partner with portfolio leaders to strengthen executive narratives and leadership-ready materials, including the strategic choices, supporting evidence, and decisions required.
Assess the effectiveness of Technology Portfolio Reviews and evolve the cadence and content as product management maturity grows.

MBR, QBR, and Product Operating Rhythms

Establish and continuously improve standards for Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews, and related product operating rhythms across Digital Product Management.
Ensure MBRs and QBRs are executed consistently across product teams and product groups and remain aligned with the Digital Product Operating Model Hub.
Define the appropriate product management rigor for recurring reviews, including outcomes, strategy, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, priorities, risks, investment choices, and value realization.
Create clear linkage between team product group and product portfolio MBR/QBR cadences and the senior executive-level Technology Portfolio Reviews used for senior executive alignment and decision-making.

Product Management Outcomes Journey and Governance

Help define and evolve Amgen’s Product Management Outcomes Journey, connecting business strategy and user needs to product strategy, prioritization, investment, execution, measurement, and value realization.
Evaluate and recommend improvements to governance, decision rights, and escalation approaches that enable effective and timely digital product and portfolio decisions.
Strengthen prioritization practices by helping leaders assess opportunities based on strategic alignment, business and user value, feasibility, risk, investment requirements, and expected outcomes.
Identify recurring barriers to outcome-driven product management and work with Product Management Hub leadership and enterprise partners to address them.

Use insights from Technology Portfolio Reviews, MBRs, QBRs, and leadership interactions to inform the continued evolution of the Digital Product Operating Model.

AI-Enabled Executive and Portfolio Preparation

Identify and implement opportunities to use generative AI, coding agents, automation, and integrated data workflows to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of portfolio and executive review preparation.
Automate recurring preparation activities such as data aggregation, synthesis of performance information, identification of trends and risks, narrative drafting, and presentation development.
Partner with Technology, AI, Data, and Product Operations teams to improve access to reliable product, portfolio, financial, and performance information used in leadership forums.
Establish appropriate human review and quality controls so AI-assisted materials are accurate, trusted, and appropriate for executive decision-making.

Enterprise Partnership and Executive Facilitation

Act as a connector across Product Management, business leadership, Finance, the Results Delivery Office, Technology Transformation, the broader Technology organization, AI and Data, and other enterprise stakeholders.
Partner with Finance to strengthen the connection between product strategy, portfolio priorities, investment planning, financial decision-making, and value realization.
Partner with the Results Delivery Office and Technology Transformation to align product and portfolio outcomes with enterprise priorities, performance mechanisms, and broader technology transformation.
Serve as a trusted advisor and facilitator to digital product leaders, bringing structured problem solving, product management expertise, and clear decision framing to complex cross-functional discussions.
Influence across organizational boundaries without formal authority and translate recurring insights into improved Digital Product Operating Model standards, guidance, measurement, and enablement.

What We Expect Of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Product Management leader we seek combines deep product management expertise, enterprise strategic thinking, structured problem solving, executive-level communication, and the ability to navigate effectively across Product Management, business, Finance, Technology, AI and Data, and transformation leadership.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 4 years of experience in Digital Product Management, Product Operations, Digital Transformation, or related management consulting experience.
